newsitem.title: USA: Josephthal says J.W. Charles to pay it $1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Josephthal says J.W. Charles to pay it $1.1 mln.

text.p: A New York Stock Exchange arbitration panel Thursday ordered J.W. Charles, its chairman, Marshall Leeds and the former branch managers of Josephthal's Atlanta office to pay Josephthal Lyon & Ross Inc an aggregate of $1.1 million, Josephthal said in a statement.

The panel found that Josephthal branch managers Paul Mannion and John Clarke conspired with J.W. Charles and Leeds to hire away all of the brokers from Josephthal's Atlanta branch office to work for J.W. Charles, Josephtal said.
J.W. Charles vice chairman Joel Marks said the firm is "disappointed" with the panel's findings.
Marks said he is confident that J.W. Charles will previal when the matter is brought before a court.
